g.aria-label: Title text 'December 2025 pair, day-ahead forecasts. Coverage is scored against the NRA, an estimate that is not drawn. Dashed lines: the maintainer's dates (2025-12-30 01:00 and 2026-01-14 11:30). The observed readings match these dates. W is A1 with its band widened about its median by a constant factor per fold month (a month without a fitted factor takes the mean of the fitted months): 2025-12 x1.077, 2026-01 x1.073. D5'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: December 2025 pair, day-ahead forecasts. Coverage is scored against the NRA, an estimate that is not drawn.
Dashed lines: the maintainer's dates (2025-12-30 01:00 and 2026-01-14 11:30).
The observed readings match these dates.
W is A1 with its band widened about its median by a constant factor per fold month (a month without a fitted factor takes the mean of the fitted months): 2025-12 x1.077, 2026-01 x1.073.
